title: Black Lentils with Roasted Vegetables
subtitle: with whipped goat's cheese and pine nuts
description: Black lentils with roasted onion, broccoli, sweet potato and spinach, scented with za'atar and sumac and served with a whipped goat's cheese cream.

steps.text: Place the lentils in a pot with water to cover plus 2 cm. Cook over high heat for about 15 minutes until al dente. Drain.
Mix 2 tablespoons of olive oil with the chopped onions and cook in a combination microwave on the grill setting at full power for 5 minutes or until browned.

Mix the roasted onion with the remaining ingredients except the spinach (including the cooked lentils, lemon juice and zest and the rest of the oil), transfer to a suitable dish and cook in the microwave on the grill setting at full power for 10 minutes.
Remove, stir in the spinach and return to the microwave for another 4 minutes.

Without a combination microwave: fry the onion in a pan with 2 tablespoons of olive oil until golden, add the remaining ingredients except the spinach and broccoli and bake in an oven preheated to 200°C on turbo for 20 minutes. Add the broccoli and bake for 5 more minutes, then add the spinach, mix lightly and bake for 5 more minutes.
For the cream, whip the cream to soft peaks, add the room-temperature goat's cheese and continue whipping only until combined.
Sprinkle the dish with fresh za'atar leaves and toasted pine nuts and serve with the whipped cheese on the side.
